a.lede: A meteorite found in the Sahara is a rare piece of Mars' ancient crust.
a.title: Rare meteorite from Mars gives us a view into its ancient crust

b.lede: The 4.1-billion-year-old meteorite is a “Rosetta Stone for Mars,” preserving clues about how the Martian environment has changed since the solar system formed.
b.title: Ancient Meteorite Found in the Sahara Holds Secrets About Mars’ Watery Past
